findings.title: "Open the dashboard" quick action creates a chat instead of opening the dashboard
findings.detail: On the home page, clicking the "Open the dashboard" suggestion button created a new chat titled "Open the dashboard" instead of navigating to the dashboard page.
findings.expected: Clicking "Open the dashboard" should navigate to /dashboard.
findings.actual: A chat entry "Open the dashboard now" appeared in Recent chats; no navigation occurred.

findings.title: FAPI worksheet FAT deduction uses a relevant tax factor of 1.9 (FAT 100 → deduction 190)
findings.detail: On /fapi, with Foreign accrual tax paid (FAT) = 100.00 USD, the "FAT deduction" line shows 190.00 USD (256.50 CAD @ 1.35). This implies a relevant tax factor (RTF) of 1.9 under s.91(4). The RTF for a corporation is 1 divided by its general corporate income tax rate; since 2016 that is 1/0.3867 ≈ 2.585, and historically it has been values like 4, 3, 2.2 — but not 1.9. Net FAPI (24,810 = 25,000 − 190) is internally consistent, but the 1.9 multiplier should be verified against the intended tax year/jurisdiction, as an incorrect RTF over- or under-states the s.91(4) deduction.
findings.expected: FAT deduction = FAT × relevant tax factor, using the correct RTF for the tax year (≈2.585 for a corporation post-2016).

findings.title: FAPI worksheet FAT input field does not accept edits / does not recalc
findings.detail: On /fapi, I typed 1000.00 into the "Foreign accrual tax paid" (FAT) textbox and pressed Enter. The field reverted to 100.00 and the Results summary (FAT deduction 190, Net FAPI 24,810) did not change.
findings.expected: Editing the FAT input should update the field and recompute the FAT deduction and Net FAPI.
findings.actual: Value reverted to 100.00; no recalculation occurred.
